title: TelephonyProvider - Tooling API
description: Represents the telephony provider configuration and trust settings for Agentforce Contact Center BYOC integrations. This object is available in API version 68.0 and later.

Country.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Country.description: Country associated with the telephony provider.

DeveloperName.description: Unique name of the object in the API.

ExternalIdentifier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalIdentifier.description: Identifier for the external telephony provider.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update

MasterLabel.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
MasterLabel.description: User interface label for the telephony provider configuration. This internal label doesn’t get translated.

ProviderName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
ProviderName.description: Unique name for the telephony provider.

TrunkType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TrunkType.description: Type of trunk relationship with the provider. Possible values are: Secondary: Associates the provider with a SecondaryTelephonyProvider record. Trusted: Associates the telephony provider with a TrustedTelephonyProvider record.

special_access_rules: To access TelephonyProvider, you must have the Agentforce Contact Center Admin (Salesforce Voice) permission set assigned.
